_doc: Fills the one BF16 cell Figure 4 panel (d) plots but never measured:
GPT-OSS-20B, 90K input, batch 8. BF16 admits b10 at 90K, so bs8 fits --
it was simply absent from the fp32 study's ladder [1,4,10,16,32,...].
Serve settings copied verbatim from throughput_gptoss20b_fp32 so the new
point is comparable to the bs1/bs4 BF16 values already in the figure.
BF16 does not use mixed KV, so it is unaffected by the SWA flush defect.
